{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 9:45). Only statement: Priya at 9:15 told everyone 'Under a minute, hands off and enjoy the fall!' Picture: whole fish still dark and connected from nose through both body arcs, crossing, and both tail tips. No pale or stranded dominoes, no hand labels, so nobody was touching anything. Fish intact going into the push. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting anyone with the build itself.

Maya: No new observations. Earlier honest, proactive disclosure of the nudge; intact tail supports her handling. Execution and collaboration good.

Priya: Her time call and hands-off reminder is a small but real coordination/leadership act, and the team's hands-off state matches it. Still thin evidence for impact or leadership beyond that; don't over-rate. Collaboration solid, tone positive.

Leo: No new observations. Visit 1 process leadership (stop touching, keep clear of the tail, call out and fix knocks) appears to have held, since the table stayed clean. Can't separate his influence from the team's discipline, so credit moderately.

Tom: Silent and unobserved on all four visits. No basis to rate up or down. Don't penalize quiet. Ask him privately before the review what he did and checked; rate on what he tells me and any corroboration.

Team: Calm, disciplined, hands-off finish, good error-reporting norms. Result looks strong; judging outcome will come after the push."}
